generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the broadleaf base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the broadleaf program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full, Ribes: calyx-tube adnate to the 1-celled ovary and more or less produced beyond it; petals inserted on its throat; calyx-lobes, petals and stamens 5; placentae 2, styles 2. Family summaries (as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read) add flowers actinomorphic and sepals often larger than the small petals.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 34 Grossulariaceae (currants and gooseberries): shrubs, often spiny; leaves often clustered, simple, pleated or rolled in bud; stipules absent or joined to the leaf stalk; fruit a pulpy berry crowned by the persistent calyx.
